parts.name: Type I Cross Recessed Fillister Head Tapping Screw ANSI B18.6.4 1-42 x 0.1875 Type AB Steel Grade 2 Plain v1
Pan Head Screw DIN EN ISO 7045 - M2.5 x 4 - H Steel 4.6 Plain v1
MG90S 9g Micro Servo Medium Horn 12 holes
EISCO 100 mL PP beaker x3 (developer, soap+dye, warm water)

params.name: board_front_margin
params.comment: Board front edge to table front edge

params.name: sv_ear_z
params.comment: M45CHW case bottom to ear underside (listing drawing)

params.name: sv_hole_dx
params.comment: M45CHW ear hole spacing along length

params.name: sv_axis_from_end
params.comment: Output axis to nearer case end MEASURE

params.name: sv_horn_face_z
params.comment: Spline top 46 + 2 mm flange of 25T Al disc horn, hub down. MEASURE; shim with M3 washers

params.name: ls_size
params.comment: 3.7 in lazy Susan (B08CY2P8KZ) - fastened with VHB tape, holes not used

params.name: bottle_d
params.comment: Karter 250 mL narrow-mouth Erlenmeyer base OD (B006VYY10Y)

params.name: st_pitch
params.comment: Mixing pocket centre to bottle centre

params.name: st_travel
params.comment: Stage travel WORK to ERUPT along -Y

params.name: st_servo_gap
params.comment: Gap under ST-01 servo case; keeps crank underside at Z 56

params.name: funnel_h
params.comment: EISCO funnel cone height above flask neck (104 overall - 33 stem)

params.name: pocket_d
params.comment: Inside dia of every beaker pocket

params.name: tt_disc_z
params.expr: max(tt_floor_t + sv_horn_face_z; tt_floor_t + sv_body_h + tt_case_clr + ls_t + 2 * ls_tape)

params.name: st_alpha
params.comment: Link angle at each end of travel

params.name: st_gx
params.expr: work_x + 86 mm + sqrt(( st_link / 1 mm ) ^ 2 - ( ( st_travel / 2 ) / 1 mm ) ^ 2) * 1 mm

params.name: sv_shaft_top
params.comment: M45CHW case bottom to spline top (listing drawing)

params.name: sv_screw_pilot
params.comment: Pilot hole for the servo's own self-tapping screws

params.name: case_relief
params.comment: Gap under the servo case so the ears seat first

params.name: rail_xf_y
params.comment: Front X-rail centre Y = stock SO-101 base front through-hole row (base-local Y -24.4)

params.name: rail_xb_y
params.comment: Back X-rail centre Y = stock SO-101 base back through-hole row (base-local Y +45.4)

params.name: rail_x0
params.comment: X-rails start X (butt against left Y-rail)

params.name: arm_base_z
params.comment: Arm base underside = top of 2020 X-rails

params.name: tt_case_clr
params.comment: Servo case top to lazy Susan underside

params.name: horn_shim
params.comment: Nominal gap deck boss to horn face; fill with M3 washers

params.name: tt_horn_boss
params.comment: Deck boss reaching down to the horn

params.name: ls_tape
params.comment: 3M 4950 VHB (B007Y7GIKI) under and over the lazy Susan
